description: Full-text search across API modules, endpoints (name, path, description) and the integration guides (Shop Micro Frontend, Guidelines, Webhooks). The reference is English; German search terms are understood as well (a generated language layer maps them onto the English vocabulary, e.g. 'aussteller' → exhibitor, 'gutschein' → voucher). Returns ranked hits with ids usable in get_endpoint / get_guide.

query.description: Search terms in English or German, e.g. 'create cart', 'webhook signature', 'timeslot', 'session token', 'aussteller import'

name: search_docs
title: Search ADITUS documentation
